label: Bible Study
prompt: For I have given you an _____, that ye should do as I have done to you.
verse: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
note: After washing the disciples' feet, Jesus called it an example — do as I have done.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And all these _____ shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
verse: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
note: Blessings that 'overtake thee' — not just waiting to be found, but chasing you down the road.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride _____ for her husband.
verse: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
note: The new Jerusalem comes down from heaven 'as a bride adorned for her husband' — heaven's grand entrance.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I am like a _____ of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verse: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
note: A lonely sufferer compares himself to a bird of the wasteland — the next line adds an owl in the desert.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire _____!
verse: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
note: James on the tongue: a tiny member, a big boast — 'how great a matter a little fire kindleth!'
